title: COMPONENTS
ocr_text:
COMPONENTS

Roof Side Rail Garnish
Assist Grip
Inner Rear View Mirror
Front Pillar Inner Garnish
Sun Visor
Map Light
Moulding
Glass Stopper
Hood
Wiper Arm
Windshield
Dam

♦ Non-reusable part

REMOVAL OF WINDSHIELD

1. REMOVE FRONT PILLAR INNER GARNISH
(a) Remove the assist grips.
(b) Pry out two clips by your hand.

(c) Pull the garnish upward to remove it.
